snippet.title: The Sunday Museum - Explore a small museum in this small experimental horror game!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://sunshine-error.itch.io/the-sunday-museum?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt This little "retro" experimental game lets you explore a small museum, called "The Sunday Museum". You can walk around and interact with either the signs or tv sets in each room.
